title: Coaches | Kaderblick Docs

hero.heading: Coaches
hero.lead: The Coaches area in Kaderblick contains coach records with club and team assignments, licences and nationalities. Assignments determine the organisational context; visible functions depend on your permission.

body:
Coach overview

  • Search coaches: filters by name.
  • Filter by team: shows coaches assigned to the selected team or all available to you.
  • Name, club and teams: summarise current assignments.
  • Licences and nationalities: show recorded profile details.
  • Bookmark: adds or removes the coach from your watchlist.
  • Info, pencil and bin: open details, editing or deletion confirmation. Unauthorised actions do not appear.

Create a coach

  1. 1
    Open the dialog
    Select New coach in the top-right corner.
  2. 2
    Enter master data
    Enter first and last name. Email and date of birth are optional.
  3. 3
    Set memberships
    Add the appropriate club and/or team assignment with its period.
  4. 4
    Add licences and nationalities
    Choose existing entries or—with suitable permission—create missing master data directly.
  5. 5
    Save
    Check the information and select Save.

Memberships

  • Club assignment: club, start date and optional end date.
  • Team assignment: team, assignment type, start date and optional end date.
  • Several teams: separate assignments retain parallel responsibilities and previous periods.
  • Remove entry: the bin in a row removes it from the form; the change takes effect when saved.

The assignment type comes from the coach assignment types maintained in Kaderblick. Choose the actual function; the list is not limited to a few fixed coach labels.

Licences

Under Add licence, select an existing coaching licence. Authorised people can create a missing licence type from the picker. Coach details then show every assigned licence.

Coach details and editing

The info icon shows date of birth, teams with assignment type and period, nationalities and licences. Edit opens the same areas. Assignments outside your responsibility can be visible but read-only.

Roles and relationships

  • A coach relationship links a user account to the coach record.
  • Club and team roles determine the organisational area you may manage.
  • A coach can belong to several teams without automatically receiving every club administration function.
  • Supporters see only content and actions released through their Supporter relationship.
